function commit(uint256 dayId, bytes32 commitHash) external
function reveal(uint256 dayId, string answer, bytes32 salt) external
function publishChallenge(uint256 dayId, bytes32 contentHash, bytes32 answerCommit) external
function revealAnswer(uint256 dayId, string answer) external
function claimBadge(uint8 branch, uint256 milestone) external returns (uint256 tokenId)
function attest(address user, address token, address spender, uint64 approvalBlock, bytes32 revokeTxHash, uint256 nonce, uint64 deadline, bytes signature) external

function profile(address user) external view returns (uint256 points, uint256 joinStreak, uint256 bestJoinStreak, uint256 lastJoinDay, uint256 correctStreak, uint256 bestCorrectStreak, uint256 bestCorrectAt, uint256 lastCorrectDay, uint256 lastRevealDay)
function points(address user) external view returns (uint256)
function bestCorrectStreak(address user) external view returns (uint256)
function bestJoinStreak(address user) external view returns (uint256)
function currentCorrectStreak(address user) external view returns (uint256)
function currentJoinStreak(address user) external view returns (uint256)
function getChallenge(uint256 dayId) external view returns (bytes32 contentHash, bytes32 answerCommit, string answer, uint64 answerRevealedAt, bool exists)
function getEntry(address user, uint256 dayId) external view returns (bytes32 commitHash, bool revealed, bool correct, bool exists)
function nonces(address user) external view returns (uint256)
function agentId() external view returns (address)
function owner() external view returns (address)
function publisher() external view returns (address)
function verifier() external view returns (address)
function badge() external view returns (address)
function SNAPSHOT_BLOCK() external view returns (uint256)
function lastPublishedDay() external view returns (uint256)
event ChallengePublished(uint256 indexed dayId, bytes32 contentHash, bytes32 answerCommit)
event AnswerRevealed(uint256 indexed dayId, string answer)
event Committed(address indexed user, uint256 indexed dayId)
event Revealed(address indexed user, uint256 indexed dayId, bool correct)
event StreakUpdated(address indexed user, uint8 indexed branch, uint256 newStreak, uint256 bestStreak)
event BadgeClaimed(address indexed user, uint8 branch, uint256 milestone, uint256 tokenId)
event Attested(address indexed user, address indexed token, address indexed spender, uint64 approvalBlock, bytes32 revokeTxHash, address verifier)
